why: Both narrow Corwin to towels and tissue, call for exiting the unrelated acquisitions, list all three key brutal facts and flag the Rival P and grasping-for-salvation decline risks. Analysis 1 is better calibrated (stated confidence, an explicit fallback if the softness gap cannot be closed, stricter gate verdicts), while Analysis 2 is slightly stronger on the stop-doing list with its concrete coupon test but miscounts the acquisitions and passes the decline gate despite an active decline.
